 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Occassionly'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Occasionally'.**
 
• The word '**Occasionally**' is an **adverb** which means 'at infrequent or irregular intervals; now and then'. **(कभी-कभी)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• She occasionally goes for a walk in the evening.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Occassionly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words -**

 
• **Synopsis -** a brief summary or general survey of something **(सारांश)**
 
• **Obliterate -** destroy utterly; wipe out **(संपूर्ण नष्ट करना)**
 
• **Pursuit -** the action of following or pursuing someone or something **(पीछा)**
